title: Design System: Abdullah Mohamed — Field Reference

display.purpose: Masthead name only, once per page.

label.purpose: Keys, indices, tags, metadata — addressing, never sentences.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Reveals and state transitions; single-axis, no overshoot.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One-shot entrance when elements enter the viewport; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: rail-fill
motion.purpose: Scroll-linked detent advance on the key rail.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single red action: CV download, form submit.
components.css: .ds-cv { display: inline-block; background: #d10a11; color: #08080a; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; padding: 15px 28px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cv:hover { background: #e3231a; } .ds-cv:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f43a3a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stack Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #8a8a90; border: 1px solid #26262d; padding: 4px 9px; }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #0d0d11; border: 1px solid #26262d; color: #f2f2f2; font-size: 14px; padding: 11px 13px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #d10a11; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Key Rail Key
components.description: The signature navigation key: a 30px square that fills red when its section is active.
components.css: .ds-key { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-key .sq { width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 1px solid #26262d; color: #8a8a90; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #08080a; } .ds-key .lb { font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 7.5px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #8a8a90; } .ds-key-active .sq { background: #d10a11; border-color: #d10a11; color: #08080a; } .ds-key-active .lb { color: #f2f2f2; }

components.name: Contract Entry
components.description: Ledger-style project entry: top hairline, typographic anatomy, no card box.
components.html:
CONTRACT 01 — ENGINEERING — OBLIEN

Self-hosted deployment platform — push code, it ships itself.

components.css: .ds-contract { border-top: 1px solid #26262d; padding: 26px 0 34px; } .ds-contract .idx { font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2.5px; color: #f43a3a; } .ds-contract h3 { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 10px 0 6px; color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-contract .tag { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #c9c9cf; } .ds-contract .ev { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #f43a3a; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: The site is a typeset operative file: dense dossier text set in twin columns around a keyed centre rail, evidence URLs hung in the outer margin like scholarly apparatus. Depth comes from hairlines and density, never from shadow or glow; the interface recedes so the record leads. The identity extends the established GitHub agency-dossier brand: near-black ground, signal red, tracked mono labels, file numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with one signal red reserved for keys, rules, and the primary action
Hairline rules at one device pixel (canvas ruling engine for structural rules)
Archivo display voice with Martian Mono apparatus labels
One moving part: the key rail's red detent, scroll-linked, damped, single-axis
Every claim anchored to a live URL; no decoration the record did not earn

rules.name: The Red Budget Rule
rules.body: Red covers under ~5% of any viewport. If a red element is not a key, a rule, a leader, or the single primary action, it is not red.

rules.name: The Readable Red Rule
rules.body: Red as text below 18px uses #f43a3a on this ground; #d10a11 is a fill color, not a text color.

rules.name: The Apparatus Rule
rules.body: Mono is for measurement and addressing (keys, file numbers, indices, handles), never for sentences. Prose is always Archivo.

dos: Do keep red as keys, rules, and the single primary action (≤5% of a viewport).
Do set every label in tracked uppercase Martian Mono and every sentence in Archivo.
Do collapse all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use #d10a11 for small text on the ground — use #f43a3a.
Don't add shadows, glows, gradients, or glass decoration; structure is hairlines.
Don't introduce rounded corners, pills, or emoji/glyph icons.
